source_en: Delivering timber to the city yards.
Buying supplies. Twice a season, always.
Winter grain for my livestock plot.
Iron traps for the "things" in the mist.
Trading wolf pelts for water filters.
Lamp oil. The fog comes lower nightly.
The tree line is dead. Need a roof.
Seeking shelter. The sky is watching.
Nothing grows past the north gate. Food.
To my office at city planning.
Picking my wife and kids up from school.
Moving to a flat. Never liked the forest.
Selling my cabin. Never lived outside the city.
Which way is the north gate? Never been.
Hiring a guide to teach me tracking.
Selling fresh forest mushrooms. Good harvest.
Cinema with my neighbours from the block.
Hosting a dinner party for friends tonight.
Papers. Fresh from the envelope. Something moves in the tree line.
Supplies. The trees are starting to taste like copper.
Take the form. The ink smells like old blood today.
The fog is getting teeth. I need my cabin before it bites.
The forest is gone. It didn't die; it just… left.
I don't need a name anymore. The wind doesn't use them.
Stay quiet, officer. Listen to the wind.
Watch your back, officer. The walls are getting thin.
Bury your heart deep. It’s the only way to keep it.
A den. I have slept in worse. I will wait.
Watch the door. Things follow you more than you think.
Back to the roots… the dark soil… This is… correct.
The predator… always finds you… in the end…
Where are you coming from?
The northern forest. Timber for the city yards. Twice a season.
My cabin past the north gate. Wire does not hold. I need iron.
The tree line. What is left. Nothing grows. I came for a roof.
The southern orchards. Kolkhoz apples. Never cared for the forest.
My flat in block seven. I only see woods on Sundays.
The forest. Green and full. The birds came back this week.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. Sap on my hands. Smoke in my chest. Every winter.
Stiff joints in the morning. I do not sleep. I listen.
Dry skin, cracked knuckles. The air does it. I do not complain.
Nothing. At fifty a man knows his body. Mine is fine.
Nothing. I sleep sound. My neighbours watch the tree line for me.
Nothing. Soft hands. I sit at a forestry office desk all day.
The birds left the valley this morning. They know before we do.
The wind comes from the wrong direction today. Watch yourself, officer.
You have a shadow that does not match your feet. Careful, officer.
Something moves in the fog now. Nothing I recognize. Nothing natural.
The forest did not die. It left. You do not understand that yet.
Everything that was green is gone. Stay under something solid.
